title: Workout Plan
name: Papa
howTo: Push → Back → Arms → Legs, then repeat. Sunday is rest.
Warm up first. Pick any 4–5 moves, about 5 minutes.
Each exercise: 1 light warm-up set, then 3 sets of 12.
Save your weight. Next time, try a little more.
End every day with 20 min incline walk.

rest.name: Rest Day
rest.note: Rest today. Take an easy walk and drink water.

jog.name: Walk or Jog in Place
jog.feel: Body gets warm. Breathing a little faster.
steps: Stay on the spot.
Walk or jog lightly. Swing your arms.
1–2 minutes.

wall_march.name: Wall March
steps: Hands on a wall, lean a little.
Lift one knee up, then the other.
10 each leg, slow.

arm_swings.name: Arm Swings
steps: Arms straight in front.
Swing them open wide, then back together.
10–15 times.

side_stretch.name: Side Stretch
steps: Reach one arm over your head.
Lean gently to the side.
5 each side.

wrist_circles.name: Wrist Circles
steps: Hold arms in front.
Turn wrists in circles.
10 each way.

neck_stretch.name: Neck Stretch
neck_stretch.feel: Gentle stretch on the side of the neck.
steps: Tilt your head to one side.
Hold 10 seconds.
Then the other side.

knee_circles.name: Knee Circles
steps: Feet together, hands on knees.
Move knees in small circles.
10 each way.

ankle_circles.name: Ankle Circles
steps: Hold a wall. Lift one foot.
Turn the ankle in circles.
10 each way, each foot.

toe_touch.name: Toe Touch
toe_touch.feel: Stretch in the back of your legs.
steps: Stand tall.
Slowly reach down toward your toes. Bend knees if needed.
Come up slowly. 8 times.

chest_press_machine.name: Chest Press Machine
chest_press_machine.feel: Middle of your chest. Not your shoulders.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest.
Back flat on the pad. Feet on the floor.
Breathe out and push the handles forward. Don't lock your elbows.
Breathe in and slowly bring them back.
chest_press_machine.tip: Squeeze your chest at the front for 1 second.
chest_press_machine.about: Sit and push the handles forward

db_bench_press.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Feet flat on the floor.
Push the dumbbells up until arms are straight.
Slowly lower them back to your chest.
db_bench_press.tip: Ask someone to hand you the dumbbells if they are heavy.

incline_pushup.name: Incline Push-up
steps: Hands on a bench, a little wider than shoulders.
Walk your feet back. Body straight.
Lower your chest to the bench.
Push back up.

incline_db_press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
incline_db_press.feel: Top part of your chest, below the collarbone.
steps: Set the bench at a small angle (about 30°).
Dumbbells at your upper chest.
Push them up and a little together.
Slowly lower back down.

smith_incline_press.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
steps: Put an incline bench under the Smith bar.
Unhook the bar. Lower it to your upper chest.
Push it back up.
Hook the bar back when done.
smith_incline_press.tip: Set the safety stops just above your chest.

cable_low_fly.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
steps: Set both cables low. Hold one handle in each hand.
Step forward. Arms down and a little out.
Bring your hands up and together in front of your face.
Slowly go back.

pec_deck.name: Pec Deck
pec_deck.feel: Inside of your chest, near the middle.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height.
Sit with your back on the pad. Elbows a little bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest.
Squeeze 1 second. Slowly open your arms back.
mistakes: Opening the arms too far back
pec_deck.about: Bring the arms together in front of you

cable_fly.name: Cable Fly
cable_fly.feel: Inside of your chest, near the middle.
steps: Set both cables at shoulder height. Hold one handle in each hand.
Step forward. Arms open wide, elbows a little bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze 1 second. Slowly open.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms, not the chest
cable_fly.tip: Same move as the pec deck, just with cables.

machine_shoulder_press.name: Machine Shoulder Press
machine_shoulder_press.feel: Top and front of your shoulders.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at shoulder height.
Back flat on the pad. Feet on the floor.
Breathe out and push the handles up. Don't lock your elbows.
Slowly bring them back to shoulder height.
machine_shoulder_press.tip: If there is no machine, do the same with dumbbells, sitting on a bench with back support.
machine_shoulder_press.about: Sit and push the handles above your head

db_shoulder_press.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
db_shoulder_press.feel: Top and front of your shoulders.
steps: Sit on an upright bench, back on the pad.
Dumbbells next to your ears, palms forward.
Push them up over your head.
Slowly bring them back to ear level.

smith_shoulder_press.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
smith_shoulder_press.feel: Top and front of your shoulders.
steps: Put an upright bench under the Smith bar.
Unhook the bar at chin height.
Push it up over your head.
Slowly lower to chin height.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral Raise
lateral_raise.feel: Side of your shoulders. Not your neck.
steps: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Keep elbows a little bent.
Lift arms to the side, up to shoulder height. Not higher.
Slowly lower them.
lateral_raise.tip: This works best with very light weight.
lateral_raise.about: Lift dumbbells out to the side

cable_lateral_raise.name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Set the cable low. Stand side-on, hold the handle with the far hand.
Lift your arm out to the side, up to shoulder height.
Slowly lower it.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

seated_lateral_raise.name: Seated Lateral Raise
steps: Sit at the end of a bench. Dumbbells at your sides.
Lift your arms out to the side, up to shoulder height.
Hold 1 second.
Slowly lower.
seated_lateral_raise.tip: Sitting stops you from swinging. Use light weights.

reverse_pec_deck.name: Reverse Pec Deck
reverse_pec_deck.feel: Back of your shoulders and upper back.
steps: Sit facing the machine. Chest on the pad.
Hold the handles in front, arms almost straight.
Open your arms out and back, like a wide hug in reverse.
Squeeze 1 second. Slowly bring them back.
reverse_pec_deck.tip: Very good for posture. Keep the weight light.
reverse_pec_deck.about: Open your arms back on the pec deck

db_rear_fly.name: Dumbbell Rear Fly
steps: Sit on the end of a bench and lean forward, chest near your knees.
Dumbbells hanging down, elbows a little bent.
Lift your arms out to the side.
Slowly lower.

cable_rear_fly.name: Cable Rear Fly
steps: Set both cables at chest height. Cross them: left hand holds the right cable.
Arms straight in front.
Pull your arms open and back.
Slowly return.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pulldown.feel: Sides of your back, under your arms. Not only your arms.
steps: Fix the thigh pad tight. Sit down.
Hold the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Chest up. Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Slowly let it go up until arms are straight.
lat_pulldown.tip: Think: pull with your elbows, not your hands.
lat_pulldown.about: Pull the bar down to your chest

vbar_pulldown.name: Close-Grip Pulldown
vbar_pulldown.feel: Sides of your back, under your arms.
steps: Attach the V-bar. Sit with the thigh pad tight.
Hold the V-bar, chest up.
Pull it down to your upper chest.
Slowly let it go up.

reverse_grip_pulldown.name: Reverse-Grip Pulldown
steps: Sit and fix the thigh pad.
Hold the bar with palms facing you, hands shoulder-width.
Chest up. Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Slowly let it go up.

straight_arm_pulldown.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Set the cable high. Hold the rope with straight arms.
Lean forward a little.
Pull the rope down to your thighs. Keep arms straight.
Slowly let it go up.

machine_row.name: Seated Machine Row
machine_row.feel: Middle of your back, between the shoulder blades.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at chest height. Chest on the pad.
Hold the handles with straight arms.
Pull the handles back. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly let your arms go forward.
machine_row.about: Sit and pull the handles to your belly

cable_row.name: Seated Cable Row
cable_row.feel: Middle of your back, between the shoulder blades.
steps: Sit with feet on the platform, knees a little bent.
Back straight, chest up.
Pull the handle to your belly.
Slowly let your arms go forward.

db_row.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
steps: Hold dumbbells. Bend forward from the hips, back flat.
Let your arms hang down.
Pull the dumbbells to your waist.
Slowly lower.
db_row.tip: If your lower back is weak, do the seated cable row instead.

db_shrug.name: Dumbbell Shrug
db_shrug.feel: Top of your shoulders, near the neck.
steps: Stand straight with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold 1 second at the top.
Slowly lower them.
db_shrug.about: Lift your shoulders up to your ears

barbell_shrug.name: Barbell Shrug
barbell_shrug.feel: Top of your shoulders, near the neck.
steps: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders up to your ears.
Hold 1 second.
Slowly lower.

machine_shrug.name: Machine Shrug
steps: Stand in the machine, hold the handles.
Lift your shoulders straight up.
Hold 1 second.
Slowly lower.

bar_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown (Bar)
steps: Stand facing the cable machine. Hold the bar, palms down.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Push down until your arms are straight. Only elbows move.
Slowly let it come back up.
mistakes: Leaning your body weight on it

rope_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
rope_pushdown.feel: Back of your upper arm, near the elbow.
steps: Attach the rope. Hold both ends, thumbs up.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Push down. At the bottom, pull the rope ends apart.
Slowly let it come back up.
rope_pushdown.about: Push the cable rope down and apart

vbar_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown (V-Bar)
steps: Attach the V-bar high. Hold it with both hands.
Elbows close to your body.
Push down until arms are straight.
Slowly let it come up.

overhead_rope_ext.name: Overhead Rope Extension
overhead_rope_ext.feel: Back of your upper arm, a stretch near the shoulder.
steps: Attach the rope low. Hold it and turn away from the machine.
Bring the rope behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms forward and up.
Slowly bend back. Feel the stretch.
overhead_rope_ext.tip: Stand with one foot in front for balance.
overhead_rope_ext.about: Push the rope up over your head

db_overhead_ext.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Extension
db_overhead_ext.equipment: One dumbbell, Bench with back support
steps: Sit tall. Hold one dumbbell with both hands over your head.
Lower it behind your head by bending the elbows.
Straighten your arms back up.
Elbows point up the whole time.

db_kickback.name: Dumbbell Kickback
steps: One knee and hand on a bench. Dumbbell in the other hand.
Upper arm close to your body, elbow bent.
Straighten your arm back.
Slowly bend it again.

biceps_curl.name: Biceps Curl
steps: Stand straight. Palms facing forward.
Keep elbows next to your body.
Lift the weight up toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower it all the way down.
biceps_curl.tip: You can use dumbbells or a bar. Both are fine.
biceps_curl.about: Lift the weight up to your shoulders

barbell_curl.name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall, hold the bar with palms up.
Elbows next to your body.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders.
Slowly lower.

machine_preacher.name: Machine Preacher Curl
steps: Sit with your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the handles, arms almost straight.
Curl up toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower.
mistakes: Lifting the elbows off the pad

hammer_curl.name: Hammer Curl
hammer_curl.feel: Front of upper arm and top of the forearm.
steps: Stand straight. Hold dumbbells with thumbs pointing up.
Keep elbows next to your body.
Lift the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower them.

rope_hammer_curl.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
rope_hammer_curl.feel: Front of your arm and top of the forearm.
steps: Set the cable low with the rope. Hold both ends, thumbs up.
Elbows next to your body.
Curl the rope up.
Slowly lower.

cross_hammer_curl.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
cross_hammer_curl.feel: Front of your arm and forearm.
steps: Hold dumbbells, thumbs up.
Curl one dumbbell up across your body toward the other shoulder.
Slowly lower.
Switch arms.

wrist_curl.name: Wrist Curl (Bar)
steps: Sit on a bench. Forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Hold a light bar. Wrists just past your knees.
Let the bar roll down to your fingers.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can. Slowly lower.
mistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs
wrist_curl.about: Lift the bar using only your wrists

db_wrist_curl.name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit. Forearms on your thighs, palms up, dumbbells in hand.
Let the dumbbells roll down a little.
Curl your wrists up.
Slowly lower.

reverse_wrist_curl.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
steps: Kneel or sit, forearms on a bench, palms down.
Hold a light bar.
Lift the back of your hands up.
Slowly lower.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.feel: Front of your thighs and your hips.
steps: Keep your back and hips flat on the seat.
Feet on the platform, shoulder-width apart.
Slowly bring knees toward your chest (about 90°).
Push through your heels. Don't lock your knees.
leg_press.tip: If your knees hurt, don't go down as far.
leg_press.about: Push the platform with your feet

leg_extension.name: Seated Leg Extension
leg_extension.feel: Front of your thighs, above the knee.
steps: Sit on the machine. Pad sits on top of your ankles.
Hold the handles. Back on the seat.
Straighten your legs. Hold 1 second at the top.
Slowly lower them.
leg_extension.tip: If your knees hurt, keep it very light.

hack_squat.name: Hack Squat Machine
steps: Back on the pad, shoulders under the pads.
Feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safety. Slowly bend your knees.
Push back up through your heels.
mistakes: Going too deep if knees hurt
hack_squat.tip: Keep the safety handles in reach.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet Squat
goblet_squat.feel: Front of your thighs and hips.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest with both hands.
Feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down like on a chair. Chest up.
Stand up through your heels.
goblet_squat.tip: Use a bench behind you if you need a target.

lying_leg_curl.name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down. Pad just above your heels.
Hold the handles. Hips stay on the bench.
Bend your legs and bring the pad toward your bottom.
Hold 1 second. Slowly lower.
lying_leg_curl.about: Lie down and bend your legs up

seated_leg_curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Sit with the pad just above your heels. Lock the thigh pad.
Bend your legs down and back.
Hold 1 second.
Slowly return.

standing_leg_curl.name: Standing Leg Curl
standing_leg_curl.equipment: Machine or cable, or no weight
steps: Hold something for balance.
Bend one knee and bring the heel to your bottom.
Slowly lower.
Switch legs.

db_rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Knees soft. Push your hips back, dumbbells slide down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch (around the knees).
Squeeze your hips to stand up.
db_rdl.tip: Keep it light. Back must stay flat.

adductor.name: Adductor Machine
steps: Sit with your back on the pad. Legs on the outside of the pads.
Start with legs open only as wide as is comfortable.
Squeeze your legs together.
Hold 1 second. Slowly open again.

cable_adduction.name: Cable Hip Adduction
steps: Strap the cable to the ankle near the machine.
Hold the machine for balance.
Pull the leg across in front of the other one.
Slowly return. Switch legs.

leg_press_calf.name: Calf Raise on Leg Press
leg_press_calf.feel: Back of your lower legs (calves). Stretch at the bottom.
steps: Sit in the leg press. Put only your toes on the bottom of the platform.
Legs straight, knees soft (not locked).
Let your heels go back for a stretch.
Push with your toes as far as you can. Hold 1 second.
leg_press_calf.tip: Keep the safety locks on. Go slow.
leg_press_calf.about: Push the platform with your toes

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing Calf Raise
steps: Stand holding a wall. Toes on a step if you have one.
Rise up on your toes.
Hold 1 second.
Slowly lower, heels a little below the step.

seated_calf_raise.name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit with the pad on your thighs, toes on the platform.
Lower your heels for a stretch.
Push up on your toes.
Hold 1 second, slowly lower.

incline_walk.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
incline_walk.feel: Breathing faster, legs working. You can still talk.
steps: Set speed to 4–5 km/h.
Set incline to 5–8%. Start lower if it is hard.
Walk tall. Swing your arms.
Walk for 20 minutes.
incline_walk.tip: Every week, add a little incline or speed.

stationary_bike.name: Stationary Bike
stationary_bike.feel: Breathing faster, legs working. You can still talk.
steps: Set the seat so the knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal at an easy pace.
Add a little resistance after 2 minutes.
Ride for 20 minutes.
stationary_bike.tip: Easy on the knees. Good choice if walking hurts.

stepmill.name: Stair Climber
steps: Start at the slowest speed.
Hold the rails lightly. Stand tall.
Step full steps.
Go for 10–20 minutes.
stepmill.tip: Harder than walking. Start with 5–10 minutes.
